summary: Implemented the feature in the repository without running anything or committing. New modules: monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver with save, save_batch, finalize) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver with a private static _create_file_basename, save, save_batch), both engine-free. Added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py, leaving the GIF helpers unchanged. Changed the write_nifti default dtype to np.float32. Rewrote the segmentation, classification and TensorBoard image handlers as thin adapters that delegate in one call; the TensorBoard handler gained an index parameter before max_channels. Renamed output_path to output_dir in examples/segmentation_3d/unet_evaluation_array.py, examples/segmentation_3d/unet_evaluation_dict.py and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. Added tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py and tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, and updated tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. Tests are unexecuted and unverified. Judgment calls: finalize takes no arguments and the classification handler wraps it; only None meta data falls back to the item index; the TensorBoard handler calls batch_transform once. Nothing is committed.
